'''Chatler''' (Japanese: '''ペラヒコ''' ''Perahiko''), known as '''Chahiko''' in [[Chuang Yi]]'s translations, is a {{p|Chatot}} that {{adv|Pearl}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]]. As of ''[[PS437|The Final Dimensional Duel VII]]'', he is at [[level]] 50, and his [[Characteristic]] is that he is "somewhat of a clown."

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}===
[[File:Pearl and Chatler.png|thumb|200px|left|Chatler and Pearl]]
Chatler has been with {{adv|Pearl}} since before the start of the manga. Chatler first appeared in ''[[PS338|Stagestruck Starly]]'', performing in {{adv|Diamond}} and Pearl's {{wp|Manzai|comedy}} routine in [[Jubilife City]]. During the skit, Pearl had Chatler blow the grass away, however, when Chatler did so, it revealed Diamond and {{adv|Lax}}'s lazy selves, which made both Pearl and Chatler mad. Despite ruining the act, the audience found it funny, allowing Diamond and Pearl to win the special prize. Later, the two were attacked by a group of {{p|Starly}}, and Chatler helped fend them off alongside the other Pokémon.

In ''[[PS357|Magnificent Meditite & Really Riolu II]]'', Chatler participated in {{adv|Platinum}}'s [[Gym]] battle against [[Maylene]]. He first fought against a {{tc|Black Belt}}'s {{p|Machoke}} with {{m|Aerial Ace}}. During the Gym Battle against Maylene, Chatler replaced [[Chimler]] when Chimler was struggling against {{p|Riolu}}. Chatler attacked with a supereffective {{m|Chatter}} and Maylene switched Riolu in for {{p|Meditite}}. Meditite started off a speedy {{m|Bullet Punch}} and followed up with a critical hit from {{m|Psycho Cut}}, dealing major damage. Despite the damage, Chatler retaliated with {{m|Mirror Move}} and was able to beat Meditite by copying Bullet Punch. He then went up against Riolu again and was defeated by a single {{m|Vacuum Wave}}.
[[File:Lax and Chatler.png|thumb|200px|Chatler and Lax]]
In ''[[PS359|Stunning Staravia & Stinky Skuntank II]]'', Chatler fought against some {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s in order to stop them from capturing Platinum. With [[Paka and Uji]]'s assistance, he was able to help defeat the group of {{p|Staravia}} by flying Uji's {{p|Burmy}} and allowing it to use {{m|Hidden Power}} at close range.
[[File:Chatler destroying Cyrus camera.png|thumb|200px|left|Chatler destroying Cyrus's camera]]
In ''[[PS369|Problematic Probopass & Mad Magnezone II]]'', Chatler fought [[Cyrus]] after Cyrus had {{p|Magnezone}} use its {{a|Magnet Pull}} [[Ability]] to draw out the camera hidden inside Lax's fur. Chatler quickly flew by and grabbed the camera but was subdued by {{p|Probopass}}'s {{m|Gravity}}. Chatler's {{pkmn|Trainer}}, unable to do a thing in said state, asks for Cyrus to lift the attack. This allowed for Chatler to gain his mobility and crush the camera Cyrus used to capture the images of the ruin paintings.

In ''[[PS383|Winning Over Wingull]]'', Chatler sensed two violent {{p|Wingull}} approaching and warned Pearl about the danger. Despite the warning, the two Wingull hit Pearl and caused him to lose his balance. Angered, Pearl has Chatler attack the two with {{m|Pluck}}. Despite the speed advantage, Chatler was quickly put at a disadvantage due to fighting two of them and their constant use of {{m|Roost}}. This prompted Pearl to send Chimler onto the battlefield as well until he notices an injured Wingull near him.
[[File:Chatler vs Advanced Level Grunt Chingling.png|thumb|175px|Chatler battling Chingling]]
In ''[[PS397|Outwitting Octillery]]'', Chatler worked alongside his team to reach the middle of [[Lake Valor]] in an attempt to find {{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Azelf}}. Halfway across the lake, they got attacked by [[Saturn]]'s {{p|Octillery}}, who used {{m|Octazooka}} to destroy their raft. Saturn showed up on a UFO-like vessel and grabbed Pearl while demanding to know why he was heading for the island at the middle of the lake while Chatler, Chimler, and [[Rayler]] desperately try to free him. A few minutes later, the Galactic Bomb went off, with its target revealed to be Lake Valor. Pearl and Saturn witnessed Azelf reveal itself and Saturn and his Grunts began to try to capture it. Pearl and his team attempted to stop them but were overwhelmed by the number of opponents and defeated.

In ''[[PS407|Chancing Upon Chingling]]'', Chatler was sent to look for Diamond inside the [[Galactic Veilstone Building]] in order to return [[Tru]] and [[Kit]] to him. Soon after finding Diamond, they were attacked by the [[Advanced level Grunt]] and Diamond had Chatler attack his {{p|Chingling}} with Chatter while it attacked with {{m|Uproar}} in order to mask the sound of the [[Pokédex]]. After some time, the two Pokémon became exhausted.

In ''[[PS416|Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia VI]]'', Chatler was used alongside the other Pokémon to battle against the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Dialga}} and {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Palkia}}. Despite his small size, Chatler was able to do great damage to the Dragons with the help of Diamond and Pearl's Pokémon and with a combined technique, they were all able to destroy the [[Red Chain]]s controlling them.

==={{MangaArc|Platinum}}===
In ''[[PS434|The Final Dimensional Duel IV]]'', Pearl intended to use Chatler alongside the rest of his team to fight [[Charon]] and his {{p|Heatran}} but [[Reg]] showed up with {{TP|Diamond|Rotom}}'s appliances, allowing it to defeat him.

In ''[[PS441|The Final Dimensional Duel XI]]'', Chatler tried to stop Charon from closing the portal to the [[Distortion World]] with his machine. Charon quickly uses the machine to control Chatler and have him attack his own Trainer instead. Rotom then showed up in a [[Proteam Omega]] toy and destroyed the machine.

==Personality and characteristics==
Like his {{pkmn|Trainer}}, Chatler is quick, impatient, and easily irritable, taking most of his anger out on {{adv|Diamond}}'s {{p|Munchlax}}, {{adv|Lax}}, in a manner similar to how {{adv|Pearl}} behaves towards Diamond. He is a fairly strong fighter and is occasionally used for battling, though Pearl tends to use [[Chimler]] over him. Pearl occasionally uses him to listen in on conversations and repeat them.
